behaviors.title: Compass prepares changes without ratifying drafts
invariants: Draft and invalid intent remain unaccepted and visible.
Completion uses the actual diff, current affected intent revisions, and source-bound required proof.

scenarios.title: Affected scope and proof survive projection without invented readiness
scenarios.oracle: Regression cases preserve legacy root summaries; retain draft, invalid and dangling neighbors; detect stale proof, renamed paths, scope expansion and concurrent intent edits; allow verified bounded changes despite unrelated legacy gaps; and emit no work for rejected modernization.
